title: Normalized supported scalar maps
statement: For a ring map φ : ULift (ZMod N) → A, construct coefficient maps between the ordinary constant module sheaves [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on a closed support D and its ambient scheme T. On every étale object, each map sends the sheafification of r to the sheafification of φ(r). More generally, any two maps with these generator formulas, for arbitrary commutative coefficient rings and any morphism i : D → T, commute with the constant adjunction unit [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary], under the objectwise restriction-of-scalars/direct-image comparison [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: Define the coefficient map by the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction from the linear map r ↦ φ(r) times the target section one. The adjunction identity proves its terminal-object formula. Naturality of the sheafification units and of the map transports this formula to every étale object.

Precompose the supported constant unit with the constant-presheaf sheafification unit. Unfolding uniqueness of left adjoints, naturality and the triangle identities identify it with restriction of the target sheafification unit. To compare the coefficient/unit composites, the constants adjunction and linearity reduce equality to the generator one at the terminal object. The generator formulas on D and T identify both values with the same restricted φ(1).
